text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- About 500 officials start a five-day conference to debate economic and social development strategy.
- Boufarik, south of Algiers, buried victims of a car bomb.
- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia chairs a national committee to prepare referendum on amending the constitution.
- U.S. Assistant Secretary Robert Pelletreau told a news conference: "Algerian President Liamine Zeroual can count on Washington'support".
- Air Algerie's pilots union leader on hunger strike.
- Algeria remembers leading Rai singer Cheb Hosni who was was murdered two years ago.
